title: Back-end
description: Set up a basic back-end using Fastify and Bun in Typescript
close_reason: Set up Fastify back-end with Bun: server entry point at src/index.ts with health check and root endpoints, dev script with watch mode, build script with bun bundler

title: Front-end
description: Set up a basic react front-end with bun and React in Typescript, runnable from host and docker
close_reason: Set up React 19 front-end with Vite 7, TypeScript, and Bun. Includes Vite dev server config, basic App component with counter, CSS baseline styles, proper tsconfig with path aliases, updated Dockerfile for dev/prod Docker support, and docker-compose volume configuration.

title: Project Structure
description: Set up monorepo directories, with a back-end, front-end and shared directory. As well as any configuration files needed for bun, typescript, eslint and docker
close_reason: Monorepo structure set up with back-end, front-end, and shared directories. Configuration files created for bun workspaces, TypeScript (composite project references), ESLint v9 flat config, Docker (Dockerfiles + docker-compose), and .gitignore.

title: CSS Styling
description: Set up CSS styling using ShadCN components for React
close_reason: Set up Tailwind CSS v4 with Vite plugin, initialized ShadCN UI with Stone color theme (OKLCH colors, dark mode support). Added Button, Card, and Badge components. Updated App.tsx to demonstrate ShadCN component usage. All checks pass: TypeScript, ESLint, and Vite build.

title: Docker compose
description: Validate that both back-end and front-end start correctly via docker-compose
close_reason: Fixed back-end Dockerfile for monorepo-aware builds, added tsconfig.json to both Docker dev stages, added back-end node_modules volume to docker-compose. Both services validated: back-end (Fastify on :3001) and front-end (Vite on :5173) start and respond correctly.

title: Typescript rules
description: Implement best practice typescript rules and a personal preference: using ";" at the end of a line
close_reason: Added strict TypeScript compiler rules (exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, verbatimModuleSyntax, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature). Upgraded ESLint to strictTypeChecked + stylisticTypeChecked presets. Added @stylistic/eslint-plugin for semicolon enforcement in member delimiters. Added consistent-type-imports, explicit-function-return-type, no-console, eqeqeq rules. Fixed all existing code to comply.

title: Shared Example
description: Add a reference example of a typescript interface and type that can both be used in the back-end and front-end
close_reason: Added HelloResponse interface, HealthCheckResponse interface, and ServiceStatus type to shared module. Both front-end (HelloButton) and back-end (health check route) now import and use the shared types. Demonstrates cross-package type sharing in the monorepo.

title: Integration - Front
description: Add a simple button to the front-end UI that will request "hello" from the back-end
close_reason: Added 'Say Hello' button to front-end that requests /hello from the Fastify back-end. Includes: API client utility (apiFetch/apiGet with ApiError class), HelloButton component with ShadCN styling (loading/success/error states), Vite dev proxy config (/api -> localhost:3001), and integration card in App.tsx.

title: Health Check
description: Add a health check to the back-end that can be accessed for periodic health checks
close_reason: Added Docker HEALTHCHECK instruction to back-end Dockerfile (dev and prod stages) that probes GET /health every 30s with 10s start-up grace period. Added healthcheck config to docker-compose.yml. Enhanced health endpoint with rounded uptime and JSDoc documentation. Uses shared HealthCheckResponse type.

title: Integration - Back
description: Add a response to the back-end that responds with "hello"
close_reason: Added GET /hello endpoint to Fastify back-end that responds with { message: 'hello', timestamp: '<ISO>' } using the shared HelloResponse interface. Completes the full front-end to back-end integration: HelloButton → /api/hello → Vite proxy → GET /hello → Fastify.

title: Endpoint mismatch
description: Make sure that the API_BASE const is also used in the back-end, then update tests
